create_resize_shortest_edge_transformer: create a ResizeShortestEdge transformer to resize RGB depth and semantic observation tensors to a target shortest edge size
create_center_cropper_transformer: create a CenterCropper transformer to center crop RGB depth and semantic observation tensors to a fixed height and width
create_cubemap_to_equirect_transformer: create a CubeMap2Equirect transformer to stitch six cubemap camera sensors into a single equirectangular 360 degree image
create_cubemap_to_fisheye_transformer: create a CubeMap2Fisheye transformer to stitch six cubemap camera sensors into a fisheye image using the Double Sphere Camera Model
apply_obs_transforms_batch: apply a list of observation transformers to a batch of observation tensors and return the transformed batch
